feedback.worked_solution:
The vertex of an upward-opening parabola is the lowest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/44d88798d30ce40741b538e035054ea253d50a59134d0d714bbb1d2af526e493.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(-6,-6).$
